stream_sheet.risk: wrong-stream-commit: an utterance is wrong if any of its append-only commits is wrong (a prefix commit is wrong if its words are not the first words of the true text; a complete commit is wrong unless it equals the true text); rate over all utterances
stream_sheet.split: 722 items, numpy default_rng(0) permutation: 451 fit (fit + policy grid of calibrate) + 271 certify (LTT part)
stream_sheet.guarantee: P(rate of utterances with a wrong commit <= 0.05) >= 0.9 over the calibration draw, if calibration and use utterances are exchangeable

stream_sheet.controls_rule: an input with one or more commits counts; pass iff count <= floor(0.05 * n)
